Score bands

Signal, not certainty

The index is a coverage-pressure reading. A high score means conflict-related language is more intense, broader, faster, or more recent in the open-news graph. It is not a probability that war will start.

BandLabelPlain meaning
0-20CalmLittle current war-risk pressure in the tracked query.
21-40WatchNoticeable tension language without broad acceleration.
41-60WarningSeveral signal lenses are active at the same time.
61-80HighCoverage intensity and breadth are both elevated.
81-100CriticalThe open-news signal is unusually concentrated and fast-moving.
